verdict.rationale: Token2 offers a browser-based FIDO2/WebAuthn demo for registering and logging in with a key outside any real relying party. It also offers a TOTP toolset that generates and verifies codes locally without sending seeds to a server. Both work as practice playgrounds, but neither is a true sandbox environment for testing integrations or agent workflows. Missing for 10: a dedicated test/sandbox environment for integrations such as the Entra ID bulk-enrollment and Graph API tooling, documentation on isolating test from production data, and programmatic or agent-accessible sandbox access.
